approach: Restore a committed snapshot and fence only at provider publication
rootCause: Old worker can acknowledge a later commit while replacement is restoring the earlier revision
verifierSignal: Direct adversarial review: replacement watermark gap; AC-27 added
resolution: Fence and capture final committed watermark, catch up before publish; no reuse of old epoch

approach: Treat relative remote timeout as proof of origin expiry at destination
rootCause: Unknown network residence and clock offset prevent receipt-relative duration from proving origin absolute cutoff
verifierSignal: Direct adversarial review: delayed-frame deadline ambiguity; AC-28 added
resolution: Separate local/end-to-end and receipt-relative budgets; qualified time/error bound plus commit check for origin-cutoff methods

approach: Describe durable lifecycle result and kernel child publication as one atomic action
rootCause: Coordinator may crash between disk intent, kernel publication and disk result
verifierSignal: Direct adversarial review: duplicate child window; AC-29 added
resolution: Durable intent plus stable creation key, kernel keyed reconciliation and durable result; old-boot child reported gone

approach: Renew authenticated route and telemetry freshness from arrival age plus sequence
rootCause: Previously unseen increasing sequences can be delayed and drip-fed to renew stale state
resolution: Receiver-start bounded nonce challenges; no arrival-based renewal

approach: Replace old ingress sample with restarted source and scale from workload-wide demand/T
rootCause: New zero erases unresolved old work and affine or heterogeneous demand can spawn ineligible capacity
verifierSignal: R2 generation coverage and homogeneous domains; AC-45/46
resolution: Freeze both directions until fenced reconciliation; explicit homogeneous interchangeable scaling domains

approach: Trust controller-owned budget ledger, implicit bootstrap allowance and mutable incarnation ceilings
rootCause: Controller can mint distinct-key reservations beyond aggregate ceiling; genesis circularity and resize conflict leave enforcement undefined
verifierSignal: R3 independent enforcement and genesis/maxima; AC-47/48
resolution: Issuer-precommitted keyed genesis; isolated fixed-home Authority with live atomic destination claims; immutable maxima/current limits

approach: Accept controller Ready membership without destination-backed provenance
rootCause: Unrelated same-schema live export can satisfy method checks while violating application artifact/tier policy

approach: Forward reusable subject/method proof with router-selected target
rootCause: Router can change payload/deadline/operation or attenuate same origin to two destinations
verifierSignal: R5 immutable origin operation and one sealed target; AC-50
resolution: Origin issuer seals immutable request and single target in bounded operation-owned record; destination validates replay/correlation

approach: Complete Files Grid before shared thumbnail extraction in its dependent Quick Look phase
rootCause: Grid requires a decoder supplied only after Files completes, creating a hidden dependency cycle or duplicate decoder implementation
resolution: Extract shared bounded image/thumbnail primitives in Ocel cutover P06; Files P07 depends on it

approach: Cancel non-preemptible PDF work by hiding results and quarantining grants until voluntary completion
rootCause: A stuck C render can retain the sole provider slot and resources indefinitely; cancellation alone cannot enforce the execution deadline
resolution: Killable provider generation with lifecycle-owner watchdog and confirmed death before resource retirement

approach: Inherit terminal stdin into spawned children without a foreground reader lease
rootCause: Background child or unsuspended shell can compete with the foreground command for the same keystrokes
resolution: Exactly one session stdin reader; atomic foreground transfer, prompt restoration, background EOF unless redirected

approach: Overwrite destination while copying and delete source after output completion without source revision binding
rootCause: Concurrent source edits can yield mixed content and overwrite cancellation/disk-full can destroy the previous destination before copy succeeds
resolution: Stable source lease/revision, staging destination and supported safe replacement; source revalidation before removal
